_comment: Example MCP client config running this server in a hardened Podman container. Copy the ddg-search entry into your client's own config (LM Studio mcp.json, Claude Desktop claude_desktop_config.json, or a project .mcp.json). Named example.mcp.json rather than .mcp.json so it is not auto-loaded as a project config. Swap `podman` for `docker` if that is what you run. See the README section 'Running in a container'.
